examples.english: Even when tired, she greets customers with a smile.

notes:
{笑顔|えがお} refers specifically to a smiling facial expression. Unlike ⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧ (laughter), it describes the visual appearance of a smile rather than the act of laughing. It always carries a positive connotation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {笑顔|えがお}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (with a smile — used adverbially)
- {笑顔|えがお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ (to show a smile)
- {笑顔|えがお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{絶|た}やさない→絶やす：15895_tayasu⟧ (to always keep smiling)
- ⟦{満面|まんめん}→満面：27881_manmen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{笑顔|えがお} (a beaming smile)
- {笑顔|えがお}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{素敵|すてき}→すてき：02356_suteki⟧ (to have a lovely smile)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {笑顔|えがお}: smiling face (visual appearance)
- ⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧: laugh, laughter (the act or sound)
- ⟦{微笑|ほほえ}み→微笑み：12566_hohoemi⟧: a gentle, quiet smile
- ⟦にこにこ→にこにこ：05177_nikoniko⟧: smiling continuously (onomatopoeia)

KANJI:
{笑|え} (laugh) + {顔|がお} (face). Note the readings change in this compound.
